verdict.rationale: MCP tool use is documented, but in the LangChain docs rather than as a native LangGraph feature: MCPAdapter discovers an MCP server's tools and turns them into LangChain tools (langgraph-docs-22). Community notes confirm those LangChain tools can be used inside LangGraph nodes as an optional add-on (langgraph-comm-7). So LangGraph gets MCP tools through a companion LangChain layer, backed by a single doc line. Missing for 10: native LangGraph MCP client documentation, details on transports/auth/server configuration, a LangGraph-specific worked example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
